plugin.name: Jujutsu VCS Integration
plugin.description:
Native IntelliJ integration for Jujutsu (jj), a Git-compatible version control system with a fundamentally different approach to working with code.

Why Jujutsu?

Jujutsu treats your working copy as a commit—always. No staging area, no "dirty" state. Just describe what you're working on and keep coding.

Key Features

  • Describe-First Workflow — Working Copy tool window for describing current work and creating new changes.
  • Custom Log View — Visual commit graph with inline change IDs, descriptions, and bookmarks.
  • Change Operations — Edit, abandon, and describe changes directly from the log.
  • File History & Annotations — Full file history with diff viewer and line-by-line blame.
  • Multi-Repository Support — Work with multiple JJ repositories in a single project.
  • Real-Time Status — Auto-refresh keeps the UI in sync as you edit files.

plugin.change-notes:
0.9.3

Fixed

  • **Release rejected by the JetBrains Marketplace compatibility check**: 0.9.2 never reached the Marketplace because the plugin called an internal platform API (`ProgressManager.getInstanceOrNull()`) while shielding a running jj command from cancellation. It now uses the public API. Everything in 0.9.2 ships in this release.

    • Changed

  • **The log keeps loading until a visible "parent not loaded" line resolves**: when a row on screen draws a faint stub because its parent hasn't loaded yet (common in a filtered log, where a recent match's parent match can be on a later page), the log now pages in the background until that parent arrives, then stops, instead of waiting for you to scroll. It stops at 10,000 loaded rows, so a parent further back than that still needs a click on the line to load it. A parent that a filter excludes is never chased.

    • See full release notes for details.
